solves.reasoning: Incas 'incorporated'(통합) the sun. 'powerful' gods. 'luxurious' gold objects. → incorporated-powerful-luxurious = ③
Sun was 'represented' by Saule. 'determined' the well-being. She 'tended' a garden. → represented-determined-tended = ②
Royal family 'descended' from Inti. 'tireless' white horses. 'enduring' myths. → descended-tireless-enduring = ①
①sustain OK ②honor OK ③excluded → 원문 incorporated(통합). excluded(배제)는 반대 ④agriculture OK → ③ 부적절
①represented OK ②destruction → 원문 well-being(안녕). destruction(파괴)는 반대 ③palace OK ④golden OK → ② 부적절
①chariot OK ②tireless OK ③heavens OK ④forgotten → 원문 enduring(오래 지속되는). forgotten(잊혀진)은 반대 → ④ 부적절
food and __________ → 음식과 쉴 곳을 구하며. shelter(피난처) = ①
directly __________ from Inti → Inti로부터 직접 내려온. descended(후손인) = ③
ride a __________ across the sky → 하늘을 가로질러 탈것을 타고. vehicle(탈것) = ④
sustain(유지하다) 동의어 = maintain(유지하다) = ②
depicted(묘사된) 동의어 = described(묘사된) = ①
immense(거대한) 동의어 = enormous(거대한) = ③
luxurious(호화로운) 반의어 = plain(수수한) = ④. expensive/splendid/elegant은 유사어
tireless(지칠 줄 모르는) 반의어 = weary(지친) = ②. energetic/vigorous는 유사어, restless는 다른 의미
(A) descended from Inti = 후손이다. (B) descended the stairs = 내려가다. 서로 다른 의미 → ④
two-wheeled vehicle pulled by horses, racing or battle = chariot(전차) = ②. vehicle은 일반, carriage/wagon은 다른 종류
the __________ (well) of all life → the + 명사. well → well-being(안녕/행복)
in most __________ (myth) → most + 복수명사. myth → mythology → mythologies
held in __________ in most mythologies → 명예의 자리에 놓였다. a place of honor = ①
sun has been __________ in most enduring myths → 핵심 인물. a central figure = ③
